items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛：安东内利再夺冠，虚拟安全车令诺里斯痛失胜利
items.summaryZh: 在F1首次于马德里赛道赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛中，安东内利夺冠。杆位发车的诺里斯在比赛初段轻松拉开差距，但在虚拟安全车（VSC）出动后随即进站，导致名次大幅下滑，最终失去胜利。

items.originalTitle: F1西班牙大奖赛：Kimi Antonelli再夺冠，虚拟安全车令Lando Norris痛失胜利
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli won the Spanish Grand Prix, Formula 1's first race at the Madring, as polesitter Lando Norris lost the victory after pitting right after a virtual safety car intervention. Norris had comfortably pulled away in the early stages but the strategy call dropped him far back.
detailZh: F1 西班牙大奖赛：安东内利 再次获胜，VSC 让 诺里斯 付出代价
在 Norris 的强劲驾驶出现意外后，Antonelli 赢得了本赛季的第八场胜利
安东内利 在西班牙大奖赛中胜出，这是 Formula 1 在 马德里赛道 赛道举行的首场比赛，而杆位发车的 诺里斯 的比赛因策略而脱轨。
Norris 在比赛初期轻松拉开差距，但他在虚拟安全车介入后立即进站，这使他落后太多，以至于失去了胜利。
比赛一开始就乱作一团，领先集团纷纷切弯
倍耐力赛前预测软胎与中性胎在起步阶段的圈速差距为2.31秒，因此第二排发车的马克斯·维斯塔潘和刘易斯·汉密尔顿选择红色胎壁的软胎，而杆位得主诺里斯和身旁的安东内利则未作此选择，这一对比颇为有趣。
汉密尔顿的起步确实更好，但进入1号弯时已无空间发动进攻，随后便出现了（轻微的）混乱。安东内利和维斯塔潘都在2号弯切了弯，但梅赛德斯车手立即将领先位置交还给了诺里斯（并在接下来的一组弯道中再次让出），而红牛车手则保住了对法拉利的优势。
维斯塔潘坚称，由于汉密尔顿驾驶失控，他不得不采取避让动作，但红牛车队坚持要求他确保避免受罚，于是维斯塔潘在第4圈让当时领先的安东内利和汉密尔顿超过了自己。
几秒钟后，这位七届世界冠军开始抱怨刹车问题。他在第五圈开始失去速度，第六圈冲出赛道，并在被反复要求进站后退出比赛。
第10圈，Norris领先Antonelli五秒，领先Verstappen 11秒，领先勒克莱尔 13秒，领先拉塞尔 15秒；劳森又落后15秒，领跑‘中场’集团。
迈凯伦和Norris的战术失误？
另一起刹车问题，这次是斯特罗尔，让这位加拿大车手在第13圈退赛，并引发了虚拟安全车介入。Antonelli、Verstappen和Russell进站——尽管后者像Leclerc和Piastri一样使用硬胎起步——但Norris和Leclerc分别使用中性胎和硬胎留在赛道上。
比赛领先者 Norris 在 VSC 时段刚结束时被叫进站。他本可以留在外面，但还是进站了，更糟的是，他的停站还很慢。这位 迈凯伦 车手回到赛道时排在第五位——落后 Leclerc 16 秒，距离领先的进站车手 Antonelli 14 秒。
不出所料，这位意大利人在第 18 圈就追上了 Leclerc，但他没有发动进攻，并在第 21 圈开始掉队。“我没有碰到墙，但转向感觉很奇怪，”Antonelli 对工程师说。到第 25 圈时，他已经落后超过三秒。
Russell 以硬胎起步后换上了中性胎，他在 57 圈中的第 28 圈就第二次进站，换回白边胎。他在第 35 圈从外道超越 Lawson，抢下第五名，但他并不认同自己的策略。“我们为什么进站？我觉得我们本可以挡住 Norris，”这位 梅赛德斯 车手说。
斯特罗尔 引发了虚拟安全车
与此同时，Antonelli 与 Leclerc 的差距一直徘徊在三秒左右，但到第 45 圈时，领先集团彼此之间越来越近。Antonelli 现在紧跟在 Leclerc 身后，Norris 则向 Verstappen 施压争夺第三，这四位车手之间的差距在四秒之内。
Leclerc 等待安全车——但未能如愿
在那个阶段，非常明显的是，法拉利在推迟 Leclerc 唯一的一次进站，希望等到安全车——虚拟安全车也好，真实安全车也好——但并没有出现，这位摩纳哥车手在第 48 圈进站。他换上了软胎，准备进行九圈的冲刺，但出站后落入了前三名和第五名 Russell 之间的无人地带。
比赛末段成为 Antonelli、Verstappen 和 Norris 三人争夺胜利的较量。尽管彼此非常接近，但他们都无法做出任何类似超车的动作——直到倒数第二圈，这位红牛车手在遇到慢车后切过了 5 号弯的减速弯，而卫冕冠军未能成功向他施压。
Antonelli 最终拉开差距，赢得了 2026 赛季的第八场胜利，击败了 红牛 和 迈凯伦 的对手。尽管 法拉利 换上了新的软胎，Leclerc 还是以微弱优势力压 Russell 获得第四名；Lawson 获得第六名，这是他重返 红牛 后的第三场比赛。
加斯利 使用硬胎完成了长达 55 圈的艰巨赛段，长时间守住第七名，期待比赛后期出现中立化，但他最终不得不在绿旗下进站，最终以第 12 名完赛。
Gasly 的 阿尔派 队友 科拉平托 以中性胎起步，在早期 VSC 下换上硬胎，最终获得第七名。
在自称“相当糟糕”的排位赛表现后，皮亚斯特里 最终获得第八名，比赛中他因起步时与 Russell 接触而立即损坏了前翼。这位澳大利亚车手始终未能达到队友的速度。
Arvid Lindblad和霍肯伯格为小红牛和奥迪拿下了剩余可得的积分，排在为哈斯车队出战的第11名奥康之前。这三位车手和Colapinto一样，都在虚拟安全车期间进站——这表明这是最优策略。
在排名最后七位车手中，阿尔本是唯一一位充分利用了廉价进站机会的人——其他人都错失了良机。
当地车迷一定会对阿隆索和塞恩斯为争夺第17名而发生的碰撞感到沮丧，这次碰撞损坏了阿斯顿·马丁的前翼，而威廉姆斯车手则被罚时五秒。
Alonso最终正好以这个名次完赛，而Sainz则是四位退赛车手之一，另外三位是Sergio Perez以及前述的Stroll和Hamilton。
detailEn: F1 Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli wins again as VSC costs Lando Norris
Antonelli took his eighth victory of the season after Norris’ strong drive went awry
Kimi Antonelli prevailed in the Spanish Grand Prix, Formula 1’s first race at the Madring, as polesitter Lando Norris’ race was derailed by strategy.
Norris comfortably pulled away in the early stages of the race, but he pitted right after a virtual safety car intervention, which pegged him so far back that he lost the victory.
Scruffy start as frontrunners cut corners

Pirelli predicted a 2.31m difference between soft and medium tyres at the start, so it was interesting for second-row starters Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton to pick the red-walled compound, unlike polesitter Norris and Antonelli alongside him.

Hamilton did take a better launch but ran out of space to launch an attack into Turn 1, after which (mild) chaos ensued. Both Antonelli and Verstappen cut Turn 2, but while the Mercedes driver handed the lead back to Norris straight away (and did so again in the next sequence of corners), his Red Bull counterpart retained the advantage over the Ferrari.

Verstappen staunchly argued that he’d had to take evasive action due to Hamilton’s unruly driving, but Red Bull was adamant he should make sure to avoid a penalty, so Verstappen let Antonelli – whom he was now leading – and Hamilton by on lap four.

Seconds later, the seven-time world champion started complaining about braking issues. He started losing pace on lap five, went off the track on lap six, and retired after being repeatedly asked to pit.
On lap 10, Norris led Antonelli by five seconds, Verstappen by 11s, Charles Leclerc by 13s and George Russell by 15s; Liam Lawson was a further 15 seconds in arrears, leading the ‘midfield’.
A strategic blunder by McLaren and Norris?

Another brake problem, this time for Lance Stroll, took the Canadian out of the race on lap 13 and caused a virtual safety car intervention. Antonelli, Verstappen and Russell pitted – despite the latter starting on hard tyres, like Leclerc and Piastri – but Norris and Leclerc stayed out on mediums and hards respectively.

Race leader Norris was called in right when the VSC period ended. He could have stayed out but pitted anyway and, to compound his fate, had a slow stop. The McLaren driver emerged back on track in fifth place – 16 seconds down on Leclerc, 14 seconds away from lead pitter Antonelli.

Unsurprisingly, the Italian caught Leclerc as early as lap 18, but he didn’t launch an attack and started dropping back on lap 21. “I didn’t touch the wall, but the steering feels weird,” Antonelli told his engineers. By lap 25, he was over three seconds adrift.

Russell, who had started on hards and switched to mediums, made a second pitstop as early as lap 28 of 57 to go back to the white-walled compound. He went on to take fifth away from Lawson with an around-the-outside move on lap 35, but wasn’t convinced by his strategy. “Why did we pit? I think we could have held Norris off,” the Mercedes racer said.
Lance Stroll brought out the virtual safety car

Meanwhile, Antonelli’s deficit to Leclerc consistently hovered around three seconds, but by lap 45, the frontrunners grew closer and closer to one another. Antonelli was now right behind Leclerc and Norris was putting pressure on Verstappen for third, with those four drivers within four seconds.
Leclerc waits for a safety car – to no avail

At that stage, it was extremely clear that Ferrari was delaying Leclerc’s sole pitstop in the hope of a safety car – virtual or not – but there was none, and the Monegasque pitted on lap 48. He was given soft tyres for a nine-lap dash, but emerged in a no man’s land between the top three and fifth-placed Russell.

The end of the race was a three-way contest for victory between Antonelli, Verstappen and Norris. Albeit very close to one another, none of them was able to make anything resembling a move – until the penultimate lap, when the Red Bull racer cut the Turn 5 chicane after encountering backmarker traffic and the reigning champion unsuccessfully put him under pressure.

Antonelli eventually pulled away to take his eighth victory of the 2026 campaign from his Red Bull and McLaren rivals. Leclerc narrowly secured fourth place from Russell despite the new soft tyres on the Ferrari; Lawson took sixth for his third race back at Red Bull.

Pierre Gasly completed a mammoth 55-lap stint on hard tyres to hold seventh place for the longest time, hoping for a late neutralisation of the race, but he eventually had to pit under green flag and ended up 12th under the chequered flag.
Gasly’s Alpine team-mate Franco Colapinto finished seventh after starting on mediums and switching to hards under the early VSC.

After a qualifying performance he himself described as “pretty shocking”, Oscar Piastri ended up eighth in a race where he sustained front wing damage straight away due to contact with Russell at the start. The Australian never had his team-mate’s pace.

Arvid Lindblad and Nico Hulkenberg scored the remaining available points for Racing Bulls and Audi, ahead of 11th-placed Esteban Ocon for Haas. Those three drivers, like Colapinto, pitted under the VSC – showing this was the optimal strategy.
Among the last seven drivers in the classification, Alex Albon was the only one to make the most of a cheap pitstop – the others missed out.

Local fans will have been dismayed by a collision between Fernando Alonso and Carlos Sainz over 17th position, which damaged the Aston Martin’s front wing, while the Williams driver copped a five-second penalty.
Alonso finished in this exact position, while Sainz was one of four retirements alongside Sergio Perez and the aforementioned Stroll and Hamilton.

这是F1首次在马德里赛道赛道举办比赛。
keyPointsEn: It was Antonelli's eighth victory of the season.

items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛五大要点：安东内利再进一步
items.summaryZh: 在F1首次造访马德里赛道的西班牙大奖赛中，安东内利成为周末赢家，将冠军领先优势再扩大15分；梅赛德斯已连续第四场排位赛失利，但Antonelli表现无懈可击。

items.originalTitle: F1西班牙大奖赛五大要点：安东内利再进一步
items.summaryEn: At F1's first visit to the Madring for the Spanish Grand Prix, Kimi Antonelli emerged as the winner of the weekend, extending his championship lead by a further 15 points; Mercedes has now been beaten to pole for the fourth straight race, yet Antonelli delivered a faultless performance.
detailZh: F1西班牙大奖赛五大快速要点
安东内利还没有厌倦胜利——在马德里再夺一胜，将他的冠军领先优势又扩大了15分
安东内利、梅赛德斯、诺里斯、迈凯伦
无懈可击的安东内利再向冠军迈进一步
猜猜看？当一切尘埃落定，安东内利就是本站周末的赢家。这已经不是今年第一次梅赛德斯不是主导力量了。事实上，它已经连续第四场比赛在排位赛中被击败。
对于像这位20岁意大利车手这样经验尚浅的车手而言，F1首次造访马德里赛道本可能出现多种不利局面。但当对手们出现失误或遭遇不幸时，Antonelli总能处在正确的位置捡起那些碎片，并且以沉着冷静和一场无懈可击的57圈比赛做到了这一点。
他再次胜过Russell，而汉密尔顿因刹车故障退赛，Antonelli向着自己的首个世界冠军又迈出了一大步。
诺里斯确认自己正处于职业生涯最佳状态
抛开结果不谈，诺里斯从自己这一侧已经做了一切，去争取在四场比赛中拿下第三胜。他在Q3结束时的飞驰圈几乎被最后一个弯道的失误毁掉——但由于其余部分堪称惊艳，Lando仍然以极微小的优势夺得杆位。随后在斯特罗尔退赛触发VSC之前，他一直牢牢掌控着比赛。
Norris究竟是单纯运气不佳，还是迈凯伦本可以在策略上做得更好——除了进站时那次明显的延误之外——很难说清，但如果没有那次干预，Norris本应轻松获胜。
是的，迈凯伦在蒙扎没有竞争力，所以这位世界冠军的连胜势头就此终结，但他在马德里迅速确认自己仍处于巅峰状态。
马德里赛道的F1首秀要么会变成彻底的混乱，要么会沦为沉闷的省胎巡游。结果它变成了后者，尽管一次虚拟安全车打乱了秩序，最终让Norris付出了代价。
在炎热沥青带来的高轮胎磨损下，车手们更担心控制左前胎，而不是与其他人竞争，这场比赛证实了人们的预期：这条5.4公里的赛道根本不适合任何形式的超车。
虽然马德里赛道作为赛地在场外起步尚算合理，并在单圈中证明了它是一个令人毛骨悚然的驾驶挑战，但这位西班牙大奖赛的新家所提供的比赛动作甚至比它所取代的巴塞罗那赛道还要少。它是从零开始建造的，却浪费了一个机会。
事情的发展真是有趣，因为汉密尔顿的2026年F1冠军希望正是在西班牙开始，也在西班牙结束。仅仅七站之前，这位七届世界冠军凭借一次三停策略拿下他在巴塞罗那的第七胜，为法拉利取得了他期待已久的首胜。
Hamilton无疑情绪激动，虽然故事主线显然是他为法拉利获胜，但这也开启了向他的第八个世界冠军发起冲击的可能性。那天Antonelli的退赛让冠军领跑者与新的最接近挑战者Hamilton之间出现了41分的差距，而后者当时状态极佳，连续三次登上领奖台。
汉密尔顿、法拉利、塞恩斯、威廉姆斯
但这样的前景此后未能兑现，Hamilton自那以后仅一次登台——最终在马德里早早退赛。这位法拉利车手如今在积分榜上是在后退，而不是前进，2026年打破纪录的第八冠的所有希望基本上已经结束。
皮亚斯特里距离他上一次F1胜利已经过去一年多了，而且几乎没有迹象表明这种情况会很快改变。至少，本周末在马德里赛道赛道，他看起来从未接近终结这段干旱期。
诚然，迈凯伦在西班牙从未真正看起来有竞争力，至少在Norris以惊艳一圈夺得杆位、让所有人惊讶之前是这样，而当时Piastri以半秒之差排在第七。但两人之间的差距在排位赛更早阶段就已经很明显了。
正赛中，Piastri在起步时与Russell发生接触，当时他试图钻入一个根本不存在的空隙，结果前翼受损，掉到第10位。在队友再次争夺胜利的这一天，他第九名的成绩几乎无助于缓解他身上的压力。
detailEn: Five quick takeaways from the F1 Spanish GP
Kimi Antonelli isn't getting tired of winning - yet another victory in Madrid extends his championship lead by a further 15 points
Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Lando Norris, McLaren
Faultless Kimi Antonelli takes another title step

Guess what? When all is said and done, Kimi Antonelli is the winner of the weekend. It's not the first time this year that Mercedes hasn't been the dominant force. In fact, it has been beaten to pole for the fourth straight race.

There are a number of ways F1's first visit to the Madring could have gone wrong for an inexperienced driver like the 20-year-old Italian. But when rivals faltered or suffered misfortune, Antonelli was in the right place to pick up the bits and pieces again, and did so with aplomb and a faultless 57-lap race.
Outperforming Russell once more, while Lewis Hamilton retired from the race with brake trouble, Antonelli took another big step towards his maiden world championship.
Norris confirms he's in the form of his life

Forget the result, Lando Norris did all he could from his side to take home a third win in just four races. His lap at the end of Q3 was nearly spoiled by a mistake at the final corner - but as the rest of it was nothing short of sensational, Lando still took pole, by the tiniest of margins. And then he was firmly in control of the race before Lance Stroll's retirement triggered the VSC.

Whether Norris was simply unlucky or McLaren could've done something better with its strategy - apart from the obvious delay during the pitstop - is difficult to tell, but without that intervention Norris should've won easily.
Yes, McLaren wasn't competitive at Monza, so the world champion's winning streak came to an end, but he was quick to confirm he's still in top form in Madrid.

Madring's F1 debut was either going to be complete chaos or a dull tyre saving procession. It turned into the latter, though with a virtual safety car that jumbled up the ordered and ended up costing Norris.

With tyre wear high on the hot asphalt, drivers were more worried about keeping the front-left tyre under control than racing anyone else, as the race confirmed expectations that the 5.4km simply wasn't suitable for any sort of overtaking.

While the Madring got off to a reasonable off-track start as a venue and proved a hair-raising driving challenge over one lap, the new home of the Spanish Grand Prix is providing even less action than the circuit it succeeds in Barcelona. Having been built from scratch, it is a waste of an opportunity.

It’s funny how some things work out because Lewis Hamilton’s 2026 Formula 1 title hopes both started and ended in Spain. It was only seven rounds ago that the seven-time world champion took his first, long-awaited win for Ferrari by nailing a three-stop strategy to take his seventh victory in Barcelona.

Hamilton was no doubt emotional and while the storyline was obviously him winning for Ferrari, it also opened up the possibility of a charge towards his eighth world title. A retirement for Antonelli that day left a 41-point gap between the championship leader and his new nearest challenger Hamilton, who was in sublime form with three consecutive podiums.
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Carlos Sainz, Williams

But such promise has since failed to materialise with Hamilton taking just one podium since - ending in his early retirement at Madrid. The Ferrari driver is now going backwards in the championship standings, not forwards, and all hopes of a record-breaking eighth crown in 2026 are basically over.

Oscar Piastri is now well over a year removed from his last F1 win, and there is little to suggest that is about to change anytime soon. At least, he never looked close to ending that drought this weekend at the Madring circuit.

It is true that McLaren never really looked to be in contention in Spain, at least until Norris surprised everyone with a brilliant lap to take pole position, leaving Piastri half a second off the pace in seventh. But the gap between the two was already evident earlier in the session.

In the race, Piastri made contact with Russell at the start while trying to go for a gap that simply wasn’t there, leaving him with front-wing damage and dropping him down to 10th. His ninth-place finish, on a day when his teammate was once again fighting for the win, will do little to ease the pressure on him.

马德里赛道首秀沦为轮胎节省的巡游，5.4公里赛道被认为不适合超车，比赛观赏性不如巴塞罗那。
汉密尔顿因刹车故障退赛，自巴塞罗那为法拉利首胜后仅一次登台，2026年第八冠希望基本破灭。
keyPointsEn: Norris made a mistake at the final corner at the end of Q3 but still took pole by the tiniest margin, and he was firmly in control of the race before the VSC.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿马德里退赛后承认2026年冠军无望
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在2026年西班牙大奖赛因刹车故障退赛后表示，梅赛德斯和基米·安东内利今年“无法阻挡”，实际上承认了自己在2026年F1冠军争夺中的失利。
items.originalTitle: 汉密尔顿在马德里提前出局后承认2026年F1冠军无望
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton retired from the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix with a brake failure and said there is "no stopping" Mercedes and Kimi Antonelli this season, effectively conceding the 2026 F1 title fight.
detailZh: 在2026年西班牙大奖赛因刹车故障退赛后，法拉利车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿承认，本赛季梅赛德斯及其F1积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利将“无法阻挡”。
七届F1冠军汉密尔顿本赛季有时是安东内利在积分榜上最接近的追赶者，两个月前的英国大奖赛后他曾落后32分。
但他来到马德里时已落后安东内利76分，比赛中很快告诉法拉利他的刹车踏板行程过长，随后报告刹车完全失灵，并在第六圈退赛。
当天空体育在退赛后的采访中向他提出安东内利现在看起来“很难阻挡”时，汉密尔顿回答说：“今年无法阻挡他和梅赛德斯。我认为他们做得非常出色，他们配得上。”
汉密尔顿在马德里发车后守住第四，尽管红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘切过第一个减速弯超越了他，最终被要求归还位置——这引发了维斯塔潘愤怒的无线电回应。
“说实话，那是相当不错的比赛，”汉密尔顿谈到与维斯塔潘的事故时说。
在回答另一个关于维斯塔潘对该事件抱怨的问题时，汉密尔顿回答说：“与我无关”。
他说他的刹车问题在第六圈退赛前时好时坏。
“进入5号弯刹车时，我踩下刹车，车开始减速，然后踏板突然一沉，车没有像平时那样快速减速，我最终带着很高的速度进弯……擦到了护墙。
“之后踏板恢复了，一切正常，然后几个弯之后踏板又变长了。真的不知道这是从哪里来的。”
汉密尔顿预计梅赛德斯在下一站巴库对法拉利的优势也会很明显。
“那里有很长的直道，所以我不太确定在那条赛道能期待什么，但我会全力以赴，”他说。
detailEn: After retiring from the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix with a brake failure, Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton conceded that there will be "no stopping" Mercedes and its Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli this season.
Seven-time F1 champion Hamilton has been Antonelli's closest pursuer in the standings at times this season, and was within 32 points of him after the British GP two months ago.
But he came to Madrid 76 points behind Antonelli and in the race soon told Ferrari that his brake pedal was long before reporting a full loss of brakes and retiring on lap six.

When Sky put it to him in his post-retirement interview that Antonelli now looked "hard to stop", Hamilton replied: "There's no stopping him and Mercedes this year. I think they've done a phenomenal job and they deserve it."

Hamilton had retained fourth place off the line in Madrid, although Red Bull's Max Verstappen cut the opening chicane to get ahead of him and was eventually made to return the place - prompted furious radio responses from Verstappen.
"It was pretty good racing to be honest," said Hamilton of the incident with Verstappen.
In reply to another question about Verstappen's complaints over the incident, Hamilton replied: "Nothing to do with me".
He said his brake issues ebbed and flowed before the lap six retirement.

"Braking into Turn 5, I had hit the brake, the car started stopping and then the pedal took a step and the car didn't decelerate as fast as it would normally and I ended up carrying a lot of speed in and… brushed the barrier.
"After that, the pedal came back, it was fine, and then a few corners later the pedal went long. Don't really know where that's come from."
Hamilton expects Mercedes' advantage over Ferrari to be pronounced at the next race in Baku as well.
"It's long straights there, so I don't really know what to expect at that track, but I'll give it everything," he said.
keyPointsZh: 汉密尔顿赛前落后安东内利76分，此前在英国大奖赛后曾将差距缩小到32分。
他在马德里发车后守住第四，维斯塔潘切弯超越后被要求归还位置，引发维斯塔潘的无线电不满。
汉密尔顿预计梅赛德斯在下一站巴库对法拉利的优势仍将明显。
keyPointsEn: Hamilton arrived in Madrid 76 points behind Antonelli, having been within 32 points after the British GP two months earlier.
He held fourth off the line in Madrid, while Verstappen cut the opening chicane to get ahead and was eventually made to return the place, prompting furious radio responses from Verstappen.
Hamilton expects Mercedes' advantage over Ferrari to be pronounced at the next race in Baku as well.

items.summaryEn: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff briefly believed Kimi Antonelli had secured pole position for the Spanish Grand Prix, but Lando Norris snatched it away by the slightest margin.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯一度以为拿下杆位，直到兰多·诺里斯出现
基米·安东内利在终点线前被诺里斯以最微弱的优势击败，无缘马德里赛道杆位
梅赛德斯F1车队领队托托·沃尔夫一度认为基米·安东内利已为西班牙大奖赛夺得杆位——直到兰多·诺里斯将其夺走。
安东内利在新马德里赛道的Q3第二轮中，较其首轮1分32.140秒的成绩明显提升，跑出1分31.835秒，比所有对手至少快0.178秒。
除了一个人。诺里斯首轮成绩为1分32.525秒，尽管据迈凯伦领队安德烈亚·斯特拉描述，他在最后一弯损失了0.3秒，但他仍以1分31.824秒跃升至杆位。
沃尔夫显然没有预料到这一点——但当被问及这是丢失的杆位还是获得第二名时，他更愿意看到积极的一面。
“从那个角度看，是获得的，”沃尔夫告诉奥地利广播公司ORF。“在这个周末之前，我从不相信我们能在这种赛道布局下处于领先。”
“当刘易斯冲过终点线时，似乎很清楚我们要赢了。然后兰多在这样的条件下——天气突然变得如此炎热，而他非常擅长管理后轮过热——跑出了那样一圈。完美无瑕。”
迈凯伦在Q3之前的所有练习赛和排位赛阶段都比梅赛德斯慢，因此沃尔夫没有预料到这种性能转变。
“这也让我们感到惊讶，”他说。“但兰多过去曾展示过，他偶尔能跑出那样一圈。尤其是在尽可能控制后轴过热方面。在这方面，我认为他独一档。”
当被问及他预计比赛将如何展开时，沃尔夫特别指出了冠军争夺。刘易斯·汉密尔顿是梅赛德斯在车手冠军争夺中的主要挑战者，目前落后安东内利76分，而乔治·拉塞尔仅领先其前队友10分。
“最重要的是我们不要撞到任何东西；那对成本上限不利，”他指出。“不要输给刘易斯和法拉利积分。我认为在这里你必须得分，顺利完赛，希望能登上领奖台，希望能领先刘易斯。这样我们就达到了目标。”
detailEn: Mercedes thought it had pole position until Lando Norris came along
Kimi Antonelli was beaten by Norris on the line, by the slightest of margins, for Madring pole
Mercedes Formula 1 team principal Toto Wolff briefly believed Kimi Antonelli had taken pole position for the Spanish Grand Prix – until Lando Norris snatched it away.
Antonelli markedly improved on his initial 1m32.140s on his second Q3 run at the new Madring track, setting a 1m31.835s and outpacing all his rivals by at least 0.178s.

All, but one. Norris, whose first effort was a 1m32.525s, vaulted himself to pole position with a 1m31.824s, despite what was described by McLaren team principal Andrea Stella as a three-tenth loss in the final corner.
Wolff definitely didn’t see it coming – but preferred to see the glass half full, when asked if this was a lost pole position or a gained second place.
“It’s gained, looking at it that way,” Wolff told Austrian broadcaster ORF. “Before the weekend, I never believed we’d be at the front on this track layout.

“When Lewis crossed the line, it seemed clear we were winning this. And then Lando puts in a lap like that under conditions that suddenly got so hot, where he is so good at managing rear overheating. It's flawless.”
McLaren had been slower than Mercedes in all practice sessions and qualifying segments prior to Q3, so Wolff didn’t expect this shift in performance.

“That surprised us, too,” he said. “But Lando has shown in the past that he can occasionally pull out a lap like that. Especially when it comes to getting a handle on rear axle overheating as best as possible. And in that regard, I think he's in a league of his own.”

Asked how he expected the race to unfold, Wolff notably pointed to the title battle. Lewis Hamilton, who is Mercedes’ main challenger for the drivers’ title, currently has a 76-point deficit to Antonelli, while George Russell is just 10 points ahead of his former team-mate.

“The most important thing is that we don't crash into anything; that wouldn't be good for the cost cap,” he pointed out. “And not losing points to Lewis and Ferrari. I think here you have to score, drive home, hopefully end up on the podium, hopefully ahead of Lewis. Then we’ve reached our goals.”

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘：要赢西班牙大奖赛需先弄清在哪里超车
items.summaryZh: 维斯塔潘在F1西班牙大奖赛排位赛中位列第三，落后杆位得主诺里斯和梅赛德斯车手安东内利仅略超十分之一秒。他表示，鉴于马德里街道赛道超车极为困难，若要击败诺里斯夺冠，自己仍需弄清在哪里超车。

items.originalTitle: 维斯塔潘：要赢西班牙大奖赛需先弄清在哪里超车
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen qualified third for the F1 Spanish Grand Prix, just over a tenth slower than polesitter Lando Norris and Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli. He said he still needs to figure out where to overtake if he is to beat Norris to victory, given how difficult passing is expected to be at the Madring street circuit.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘：“我需要弄清在哪里超车”才能赢得F1西班牙大奖赛
维斯塔潘担心马德里街道赛道缺乏超车机会，这将阻碍他周日争夺胜利的可能
马克斯·维斯塔潘表示，如果要在F1西班牙大奖赛中击败兰多·诺里斯夺冠，他仍需弄清在哪里超车。
维斯塔潘在马德里新街道赛道的排位赛中位列第三，仅比杆位得主诺里斯和梅赛德斯的基米·安东内利慢了略超十分之一秒。
当被问及能否挑战迈凯伦争夺胜利时，鉴于马德里街道赛道预计超车极为困难，这位红牛车手表示怀疑。
“这会很艰难，”他说。“我的意思是，就算，比如说，最好的情况，你更快，你也超不过去。没有可以超车的弯角。所以，你得依赖别人轮胎严重退化。”
“长距离跑非常艰难，每个人的轮胎磨损都很大，所以这可能是明天的关键点。但即便如此，我仍然需要找到一个可以超车的弯角。”
维斯塔潘对排位赛表现相当满意。就单圈时间差距而言，这是自摩纳哥站以来他距离杆位最近的一次，当时他仅落后安东内利0.043秒。
“还可以，”他说。“我的意思是，今年我进入前三的次数不多，所以对我来说，我认为我们排位赛跑得不错。”
“赛车，我认为我们做了一些不错的改进，而且我觉得，我们一到这里，就处在一个，可以说，不错的窗口。然后，我认为我们一直有点挣扎的地方始终是最后一个计时段，我们似乎无法像竞争对手那样做好能量部署，这当然让匹配他们变得非常困难。”
“但总的来说，我对一切进展相当满意。每一节排位赛，从Q1到Q2再到Q3，都有不错的提升。没有什么我觉得自己留下的余地，更多是赛车本身我们知道存在的一些局限，加上最后一个计时段的能量部署，我们似乎可能没有完全做好。但这就是排位赛。我的意思是，正赛又是完全不同的。”
鉴于维斯塔潘在Q2以0.160秒的优势领先安东内利，他是否本可以期望更好的结果？
“我想我也是唯一使用了两套轮胎的人之一，所以这其实不是公平的比较，”他细致地指出。
detailEn: Max Verstappen: ‘I need to figure out where to overtake’ to win F1 Spanish GP
Verstappen fears the lack of passing opportunities at Madring will hinder a potential bid for victory on Sunday
Max Verstappen says he still needs to figure out where to overtake if he is to beat Lando Norris to victory in Formula 1’s Spanish Grand Prix.
Verstappen qualified third at Madrid’s new street circuit, just over a tenth slower than polesetter Norris and Mercedes’ Kimi Antonelli.
Asked if he could challenge the McLaren for victory, the Red Bull driver was skeptical, given how tricky overtaking is expected to be at Madring.

“It will be tough,” he said. “I mean, even, let’s say, best-case scenario, you are faster, you can’t pass. There are no corners where you can pass. So, you need to rely on people deg-ing very aggressively.
“The long runs were very tough, a lot of [tyre] deg for everyone, so that will be probably the key point tomorrow. But even with that, I need to still figure out a corner where to pass.”

Verstappen was fairly satisfied with his qualifying performance. In terms of lap time deficit, this is the closest he has been to pole position since Monaco, where he was just 0.043s down on Antonelli.
“It was alright," he said. “I mean, I haven’t been here so much this year in the top three, so for me I think we had a good qualifying.

“The car, I think we made some nice improvements, but it was also, I think, straight away when we arrived here in, let’s say, a decent window. And then, I think where we just struggle a little bit is always that final sector, where we just don’t seem to get our deployment like our competitors, and that makes it, of course, very tough to match.

“But, overall, I’m quite happy with how everything went. Every qualifying, from Q1 to Q2 to Q3, just nice progression. There were not really things that, I guess, I left on the table, just more like a few limitations within the car that we know we have, plus the deployment in the final sector where we just didn’t seem to maybe fully get it right. But that’s qualifying. I mean, the race is again very different.”
Could Verstappen actually have hoped for a better result, given he topped Q2 by 0.160s over Antonelli?
“I think I was also one of the only ones that used two sets, so it’s not really a fair comparison,” he nuanced.
keyPointsZh: 维斯塔潘对排位赛表现基本满意，认为这是自摩纳哥站以来他距离杆位最近的一次。
他指出赛车在最后一个计时段表现挣扎，能量部署不如竞争对手。
他提到长距离跑中轮胎磨损严重，这可能是正赛的关键因素。
keyPointsEn: Verstappen was fairly satisfied with his qualifying performance, calling it his closest to pole since Monaco.
He noted the car struggles in the final sector, where its deployment is not as good as competitors'.
He mentioned that tyre degradation was severe on long runs, which could be a key factor in the race.

items.titleZh: 决定马德里首场F1比赛的5大因素
items.summaryZh: F1今日在马德里马德里赛道赛道迎来首场比赛，练习赛、排位赛及F2/F3垫场赛提供了一些线索，但缺乏历史数据意味着比赛仍可能充满意外。
items.originalTitle: 决定马德里首场F1比赛的5大因素
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 heads into the unknown today at the new Madring circuit in Madrid for its first Spanish Grand Prix, with practice, qualifying and support races offering some clues but no racing history meaning surprises are possible.
detailZh: F1各车队和车手在今日的西班牙大奖赛中驶入未知领域，因为这是大奖赛赛车首次在新马德里赛道赛道比赛。这意味着比赛将如何展开存在一些重大疑问，但已有指向潜在答案的线索。
练习赛和排位赛设定了一些预期，F2和F3垫场赛的进行方式也是如此，但这里缺乏可供参考的比赛历史，意味着可能会出现一些意外。
以下是可能影响比赛的五个关键方面。
截至撰写本文时，在马德里赛道举行的五场比赛——两场F2和三场F3——中，第二位发车有四次在起步时取得领先。在周日的F2和F3比赛中，两次都是杆位车手迅速向左移动，以覆盖第二位车手更强的起步。
从电视观众视角看，杆位在左侧，这符合惯例，因为它提供了弯道通常的赛车线，第二位在右侧。
可以肯定，迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯会非常清楚杆位是否存在任何劣势，这可能意味着他会认识到需要覆盖安东内利。不过，迈凯伦通常良好的起步也可能抵消任何劣势。
发车格不同侧的抓地力往往存在差异，而且每一排也可能不同，但本周末第二位发车位的抓地力比杆位略好一些。这可能意味着安东内利在起步时有机会，而诺里斯需要根据起步情况考虑覆盖他。
马德里赛道的主要超车点是5/5a/6号减速弯，它位于2号弯后长直全油门路段之后，会颠簸路肩。
这在垫场赛中产生了最多的轮对轮较量，但大多数情况导致一辆车、偶尔两辆车切弯。正如乔治·拉塞尔所说，“设计上的一个小遗憾是缺乏清晰的超车机会”，这意味着这个减速弯将是任何人最好的机会。
“总的来说，比赛中超车会非常困难，”红牛的利亚姆·劳森说。
“在那里防守很容易，或者比普通弯道更容易，因为你只需把对方推出减速弯，他就必须归还位置。”
这意味着会有大量无线电抱怨、许多沮丧的进攻，以及在战斗中出错时可能发生碰撞或撞墙。
或者，正如亚历克斯·阿尔本所说，“如果你看了F3和F2比赛，全是车手在减速弯并排，然后抱怨其中一人没有让他们重新超过。”
轮胎退化——包括前轮颗粒化和后轮过热——一直是西班牙大奖赛周末的主要话题之一。
情况已从周五练习赛大幅改善，当时乔治·拉塞尔半开玩笑地说马德里赛道的比赛看起来要进站六次。
事实上，随着赛道橡胶化相当好，现在一停和二停之间在时间上看起来相当微妙。
因此，由于超车似乎很困难，这意味着车队可能倾向于告诉车手管理轮胎，走保守路线以尽量减少进站。
但这对于处理过热轮胎来说都很好；阻止颗粒化则要困难得多。因此，颗粒化的程度可能将是关键。
当被问及比赛会混乱还是平淡时，奥迪的尼科·霍肯伯格说：“看，这真的取决于我们是否出现颗粒化，我认为那将是主要驱动因素。”
“如果我们出现颗粒化，我认为那会相当严重，可能会很混乱。但就像你说的，你知道，你永远不知道。”
颗粒化可能引发转向不足，使高速弯变得非常困难，并引发退化水平迅速上升——带来一些策略复杂性。
所以所有目光都需要关注左前轮胎。
鉴于需要保护轮胎并可能勉强完成一停，安东内利建议“前10圈将是奶奶式驾驶”，而马克斯·维斯塔潘说“你需要依赖别人轮胎退化得非常严重”。
那么，这是否意味着这可能是一场领先者——无论是全场领先还是车群领先——可以大幅减速并轻松挡住一串赛车的比赛？
这是一条防守容易的赛道，用去年的赛车肯定会出现这种情况。
然而，由于能量部署因素，现在有可能利用巨大的动力优势在不太可能的地方完成超车，这意味着如果你过于执着于阻挡对手，你会更加脆弱。
但即使这样做机会也有限，因为有些全油门区域很容易挡住后面的车——昨天卡洛斯·塞恩斯在通往7号弯的上坡路段无意中阻挡瓦尔特利·博塔斯就说明了这一点。
回顾阿塞拜疆大奖赛的历史表明，比赛的特点往往取决于车手的集体心态。
当预测会混乱时——正如巴库多次发生的那样——车手可以改变方法。他们选择稳妥行事，感觉到远离他人的麻烦就能保证积分。
这种策略很好。然而，当每个人都这样做时，结果可能是一种平静，导致比赛沉闷。
凯迪拉克车手瓦尔特利·博塔斯认为，马德里赛道有可能不会带来其布局暗示的不可预测性——就像第一次练习赛零中断那样。
“就像FP1，如果人们太谨慎，那就会发生，”他说。
“但你永远不知道。就是这样的赛道：一个错误就会黄旗、安全车或红旗，所以肯定会有人犯错。”
尽管巴库在混乱与平静之间摇摆的例子，查尔斯·勒克莱尔认为最终马德里会介于两者之间。
“我不会用那些极端，但当然我不知道混乱方面，”他说。
“我认为在这样具有挑战性的赛道上可能会有一些红旗或事故。然而，巴库在超车方面可能相当疯狂，而在这里，我很难看到很多很多超车。”
detailEn: Formula 1’s teams and drivers head into the unknown in today’s Spanish Grand Prix as it’s the first time grand prix cars have raced at the new Madring. And that means there are some big questions about how the race will unfold, but with signposts to the potential answers.

Practice and qualifying have set some expectations, as has the way the Formula 2 and Formula 3 support races have played out, but the lack of racing history here to go on means that there could be some surprises.
Here are five key aspects that could shape the race.

In the five Madring races held at the time of writing - two Formula 2 and three Formula 3 races - second on the grid has taken the lead at the start four times. And in Sunday’s F2 and F3 races, on both occasions the polesitter moved left quickly to cover the stronger start of the driver in second.
Pole position is on the left side as the TV viewer looks at it, which is as per convention as it gives the usual racing line for the corner, with second on the right.

You can be certain that McLaren's Lando Norris will be very well aware if there is any disadvantage to being on pole position, potentially meaning he will recognise the need to cover Antonelli. Then again, it might be that McLaren's generally good launches offset any disadvantage.

There is often a difference in grip on different sides of the grid, as well as the potential for it varying depending on each row, but this weekend the second-placed grid slot has got a little more grip than pole position. That could mean an opportunity for Antonelli at the start, and the need for Norris to consider covering him depending on how the launch goes.
The main passing place at the Madring is the kerb-rattling Turn 5/5a/6 chicane that follows the long flat-out blast from Turn 2.

This has produced the most wheel-to-wheel action in the support races, but with the majority of instances resulting in one, or occasionally both, cars cutting the track. As George Russell put it, "the one small frustration in the design is the lack of clear overtaking opportunities", meaning the chicane is going to be the best chance anyone has.
"It's going to be very hard to overtake in the race in general," said Red Bull's Liam Lawson.
"It's very easy to defend there, or easier than normal corners, because you just push the guy off through the chicane and he has to give the place back."
This means there will be plenty of radio complaining, lots of frustrated attacks and the potential either for a collision or hitting the wall if you get it wrong in battle.
Or, as Alex Albon put it, "if you watched the F3 and F2 races, it was all drivers going side by side in the chicane and then complaining that one of them didn't let them back past."
Tyre degradation – both from front graining and rears overheating – has been one of the big talking points over the Spanish GP weekend.
The situation has improved a lot from Friday practice, when George Russell half-joked that the Madring race looked like it was heading for a six-stopper.
In fact, with the track having rubbered in quite well, things now look quite delicately poised time-wise between a one and a two-stopper.
So, with overtaking appearing to be difficult, that means the likely preference for teams will be to tell drivers to manage tyres and play the conservative route to minimise pit stops.
But that is all well and good for handling overheating tyres; stopping graining is a much harder task. Therefore, the level of graining will potentially be key.
As Audi’s Nico Hulkenberg said about whether the race would be chaotic or processional: “Look, it really depends, if we get graining, if we don't, I think that will be the main driver.
“If we get graining, I think it's going to be quite something and it might be chaotic. But, like you say, you know, you never know.”
Graining could trigger understeer, make the high-speed corners very difficult and trigger a rapid increase in degradation levels – throwing some strategy complications.
So all eyes need to be on those front-left tyres.

Given the need to protect the tyres and potentially eke out a one-stopper, Antonelli suggested "it's going to be grandmother driving in the first 10 laps", while Max Verstappen says "you need to rely on people [tyre] deg-ing very aggressively".
So does that mean this could be one of those races where the leader either of the race overall, or of a pack of cars, can back off dramatically and easily hold up a queue of cars?
It's a track where defending is easy, and with last year's cars it would definitely be on the cards.

However, with the deployment factor, it's now possible to use a huge power advantage to make a drive-by move in an unlikely place, meaning that you are more vulnerable if you are committing to holding up rivals too much.

But, there are limited opportunities even to do that as there are full-throttle zones where it’s easy to keep a car behind - Carlos Sainz inadvertently impeding Valtteri Bottas on the run up the hill to Turn 7 illustrated that yesterday.
A look back through the history of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix has shown that the characteristics of a race can often depend on the collective mindset of the drivers.

When chaos is predicted – as has happened many times in Baku – the drivers can change their approach. They opt to play it safe, sensing that staying out of everyone else’s trouble will guarantee points.
That tactic is all well and good. However, when everyone does it then the result can be a level of calmness that leads to a subdued race.
Cadillac driver Valtteri Bottas thinks it is possible that Madring does not deliver the unpredictability that its layout hints at – as happened when opening practice threw up zero stoppages.
“Like FP1, if people are too cautious, then that can happen,” he said.
“But you just never know. It's a track like that: one mistake and it will be yellow or safety car or red flag, so surely somebody is going to make a mistake.”
Despite the example of Baku bouncing between chaos and calm, Charles Leclerc thinks in the end Madrid will be somewhere in the middle.
“I wouldn't use those extreme ends, but surely I don't know about the chaos in a way,” he said.

“I think there may be some red flags or some incidents on a track that is so challenging like this one. However, Baku can be quite crazy with overtakes, while here, I struggle to see many, many overtakes.”
